cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-root-keys-own-the-canvas
cases.purpose: The opened reader paints its canvas with the palette, and its root keys switch the theme and close the reader instead of renderer scrolling.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-canvas-fills-the-window-without-overflow
cases.purpose: The mounted reader canvas never exceeds its window rows, so no scroll of the window can slide the sidebar and the list together with the article.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-help-stays-in-reader
cases.purpose: Both help keys show labelled effective bindings in the existing reader, search treats ? as text, Escape exits one layer at a time, and backdrop dismissal restores focus without changing the scope.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-parses-rss-atom-and-json
cases.purpose: RSS, Atom and JSON Feed fixtures parse into the documented article shape with titles, counts and publish times.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-parses-opml-and-renders-html
cases.purpose: OPML subscriptions parse with folders, article HTML renders to heading/item/link blocks, wrapping respects the column width, and relative time reads naturally.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-wraps-prose-at-spaces
cases.purpose: Prose with spaces wraps at the last space inside the column width instead of signalling an integerp error.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-new-session-is-headless
cases.purpose: A session created without a buffer starts on the all scope, in the wide layout, with no rows and no requests.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-subscribe-lists-articles
cases.purpose: Subscribing over a file URL stores the feed, reports totals and unread counts, and lists the newest article first.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-add-feed-discovers-site-feed
cases.purpose: Subscribing to a site page follows its advertised feed link and stores the discovered feed.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-broken-feed-reports-error
cases.purpose: An unreachable feed reports a readable error in the status line and leaves the reader usable with an empty list.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-scopes-filter-articles
cases.purpose: The unread, starred, feed and folder scopes filter the stored articles, and an unknown scope signals without changing the reader.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-search-finds-and-rejects-blank
cases.purpose: Search matches article titles and bodies into a search scope, and a blank keyword signals instead of querying.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-selection-moves-and-pages
cases.purpose: Selection clamps at both ends of the list, click-press selects a row, and an out-of-range press signals.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-read-and-star-toggle
cases.purpose: Read and star toggles flip the visible row immediately and update the unread and starred counts after the service confirms.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-reader-loads-and-scrolls
cases.purpose: Activating an article wraps its body into lines within the reading width, scroll clamps, and the pane switch records the choice.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-mark-read-scopes
cases.purpose: Marking above read and marking the whole scope read cover exactly the intended articles and update the unread total.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-refresh-preserves-state
cases.purpose: Refreshing an unchanged feed keeps the read and starred state of its articles.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-remove-feed-keeps-starred
cases.purpose: Unsubscribing removes the feed while its starred articles stay readable in the starred scope.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-opml-round-trip
cases.purpose: Subscriptions export to an OPML file and import into another session with the same feed count.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-theme-switches
cases.purpose: The palette cycles and sets between dark and light, an unknown appearance signals, and the UI tokens match the palette.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-declares-its-surface-to-a-host
cases.purpose: A host frames the reader from the palette, mode cell and modes it declares, so a panel's title-bar switch repaints every row instead of only the frame chrome.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-miniflux-backend-reads-a-server
cases.purpose: The Miniflux backend answers the reader's own request protocol, so a server's categories, counters, feeds and entries fill the same sidebar and list.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-miniflux-backend-opens-an-article
cases.purpose: Opening an article on the server backend requests the entry by id and renders its HTML in the reading pane.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-miniflux-backend-writes-read-and-star
cases.purpose: Read state, stars and mark-all-read reach the server endpoints and update the reader rows and counters from the replies.

cases.name: etaf-rss-tests-miniflux-backend-reports-a-server-failure
cases.purpose: A rejected server request becomes the reader's readable error while the session stays usable.
